CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS maloteTags (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  name VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  color VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT '#6B7280',
  icon VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL DEFAULT '🏷️',
  category ENUM('prioridade', 'tipo', 'custom') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'custom',
  active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS maloteTagLinks (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  maloteId INT NOT NULL,
  tagId INT NOT NULL,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  UNIQUE KEY uq_malote_tag (maloteId, tagId),
  FOREIGN KEY (maloteId) REFERENCES malotes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (tagId) REFERENCES maloteTags(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);
